name: Fey (Awakened)
body:
Awakened fey are mortal-sized fairy beings drawn from the primordial realm of dreams and wild spirits into physical mortal reality. Mercurial, elusive, and infused with seasonal magic, they navigate the world on shimmering wings.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Fey are agile, charming, and magically attuned, but physically fragile. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, and -2 Constitution.
Type: Fey. Awakened fey are fey creatures. They breathe, eat, and sleep.
Size: Small. Fey gain a +1 size bonus to AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
Speed: Normal. Fey have a base land speed of 30 feet, and a fly speed of 30 feet (clumsy maneuverability).
Languages: Fey begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. Bonus languages include Aquan, Auran, Elven, Gnome, and Ignan.
Senses and Defense Racial Traits
Low-Light Vision: Fey can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Cold Iron Vulnerability: Weapons forged of cold iron overcome any damage reduction the fey possesses and deal an additional 1 point of damage on successful melee hits against the fey.
Fey Resistance: Fey gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.
Magical and Skill Racial Traits
Primal Glamour (Sp): An awakened fey can cast disguise self and ghost sound once per day as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to character level).
Tricky: Fey gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff, Escape Artist, and Stealth checks.
